SELECT 
    pn.panemark AS panel_id,
    pn.tempcoef AS coefficient,
    e.celltempc AS temperature,
    p.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' AS efficiency_metric,
    (e.irradiance_conditions->>'irradiance_types')::jsonb->3 AS plane_of_array_irradiance,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (p.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct')::numeric 
        * (1 + pn.tempcoef * (25 - e.celltempc) / 100) 
        * (1000 / ((e.irradiance_conditions->>'irradiance_types')::jsonb->3)::numeric)
    AS numeric), 4) AS efficiency_result
FROM performance p
JOIN panel pn ON p.solmodref = pn.panemark
JOIN environment e ON p.perfregistry = e.envregistry
LIMIT 5;
